title.narrative: UNICEF supported implementation of 102 learning centers in Gaza, supporting over 70,000 children who receive three face-to-face learning sessions every week for an entire academic year. In the West Bank, UNICEF reached 53,780 children in hotspot areas through summer camps, promoting well-being and mitigating learning loss amid ongoing challenges.
